_comment: Hand-written 'what to do with it' lines for items whose game description does not say. Not read from the game files: shown on the item page labelled 'guide, not checked in game'. Key = item id.
CryptKey: Opens the locked doors of the Sunken Crypts in the Swamp. Carry it in your inventory and interact with the door.
Wishbone: Equip it to find silver: it reacts when you are close to a silver vein in the Mountains. Mine the vein with a pickaxe.
Ruby: A valuable you can sell to the trader Haldor.
Amber: A valuable you can sell to the trader Haldor.
AmberPearl: A valuable you can sell to the trader Haldor.
SharpeningStone: Used to build the Grinding Wheel. Made from Stone at the Stonecutter.
BeechSeeds: Plant it with the Cultivator to grow a Beech tree for wood. It does not need tilled soil, only open space, and it grows in the Meadows, Black Forest and Plains.
BirchSeeds: Plant it with the Cultivator to grow a Birch tree for wood. It does not need tilled soil, only open space, and it grows in the Meadows, Black Forest and Plains.
FirCone: Plant it with the Cultivator to grow a Fir tree as a wood supply. It does not need tilled soil, only open space. Also used for the Yule tree decoration.
PineCone: Plant it with the Cultivator to grow a Pine tree. It does not need tilled soil, only open space. Also used for the Yule garland and Yule wreath decorations.
CarrotSeeds: Plant with the Cultivator on tilled soil to grow carrots. Replanting a grown carrot as a seed carrot gives more seeds.
TurnipSeeds: Plant with the Cultivator on tilled soil to grow turnips. Replanting a grown turnip as a seed turnip gives more seeds.
CelestialFeather: Used to build the Feathery Wreath decoration and to craft the Staff of the Wild Dundr.
QueenDrop: Needed to build the Artisan Press.
Cultivator: A farming tool. Use it to till soil for crops, to plant seeds and cones, and to regrow grass. Made at the Forge.
Hammer: The building tool: right-click to open the build menu and place pieces, stations and furniture. You cannot block while holding it.
Hoe: Levels and raises the ground, and lowers it a little, for foundations and paths. Raising ground costs Stone and needs a Workbench nearby.
Demister: A Wisplight clears the mist around you in a small radius and follows you. It takes the accessory slot, so it cannot be worn together with the Megingjord or the Wishbone.
FishingRod: The fishing tool. Equip it, have bait in your inventory, cast with the attack button and reel in with block. One bait is used per cast.
FishingBait: Equip the Fishing Rod, then right-click the bait in your inventory to load it. The bait decides which fish bite: this basic bait attracts Perch and Pike. Better baits are made from it at the Food Preparation Table.
Fish1: Used for the Fishing Hat, for Raw Fish, and for a mead base. A catch can also give a bonus Amber.
Fish2: Used for the Fishing Hat and for Raw Fish. A catch can also give a bonus Amber Pearl.
Pukeberries: Eating them makes you sick for a few seconds and clears every food you have eaten, so you can swap foods before they run out. The cleared foods are wasted.
Torch: Held in your hand as a light source that keeps some enemies away, and it works as a weak fire weapon. Made from Wood and Resin.
PickaxeIron: A mining tool for breaking ore and rock. Made at the Forge.
PickaxeBlackMetal: A mining tool for breaking ore and rock, made at the Forge from Black Metal.
TrinketBlackDamageHealth: A trinket (one at a time). It charges as you fight; when full it heals you at once and boosts your Clubs skill and blunt damage for a minute.
TrinketBlackStamina: A trinket (one at a time). It charges as you fight; when full it makes blocking cheaper in stamina, strengthens parries and raises your Dodge skill for two minutes.
TrinketBronzeHealth: A trinket (one at a time). It charges as you fight; when full it boosts your health regeneration by a quarter for a minute.
TrinketBronzeStamina: A trinket (one at a time). It charges as you fight; when full it boosts your stamina regeneration by a quarter for a minute.
TrinketCarapaceEitr: A trinket (one at a time). It charges as you fight; when full it boosts your Eitr regeneration by a quarter for a minute.
TrinketFlametalStaminaHealth: A trinket (one at a time). It charges as you fight; when full it instantly restores health and stamina.
TrinketIronHealth: A trinket (one at a time). It charges as you fight; when full it heals you at once and adds armor for half a minute.
TrinketScaleStaminaDamage: A trinket (one at a time). It charges as you fight; when full it restores stamina at once and boosts slash damage for a minute.
TrinketSilverDamage: A trinket (one at a time). It charges as you fight; when full it raises your Bows and Spears skills and pierce damage for half a minute.
TrinketSilverResist: A trinket (one at a time). It charges as you fight; when full it gives slight resistance to blunt, slash and pierce damage for under a minute.
FishingBaitForest: Load it on the Fishing Rod (right-click it in your inventory) to catch Trollfish. Made from 20 Fishing Bait and one trophy at the Food Preparation Table.
FishingBaitSwamp: Load it on the Fishing Rod (right-click it in your inventory) to catch Giant Herring. Made from 20 Fishing Bait and one trophy at the Food Preparation Table.
FishingBaitCave: Load it on the Fishing Rod (right-click it in your inventory) to catch Tetra. Made from 20 Fishing Bait and one trophy at the Food Preparation Table.
FishingBaitPlains: Load it on the Fishing Rod (right-click it in your inventory) to catch Grouper. Made from 20 Fishing Bait and one trophy at the Food Preparation Table.
FishingBaitMistlands: Load it on the Fishing Rod (right-click it in your inventory) to catch Pufferfish and Anglerfish. Made from 20 Fishing Bait and one trophy at the Food Preparation Table.
FishingBaitAshlands: Load it on the Fishing Rod (right-click it in your inventory) to catch Magmafish. Made from 20 Fishing Bait and one trophy at the Food Preparation Table.
FishingBaitDeepNorth: Load it on the Fishing Rod (right-click it in your inventory) to catch Northern Salmon. Made from 20 Fishing Bait and one trophy at the Food Preparation Table.
FishingBaitOcean: Load it on the Fishing Rod (right-click it in your inventory) to catch Tuna and Coral Cod. Made from 20 Fishing Bait and one trophy at the Food Preparation Table.
CharcoalResin: Used to build the green pots (guide, not checked in game); the site does not list those pieces yet.
TrinketChitinSwim: A trinket (one at a time). It charges as you fight; when full it makes you swim faster for two minutes at a much lower stamina cost.
TrinketIronStamina: A trinket (one at a time). The game describes it as putting a spring in your step; its exact effect has not been checked.
